title: COMMON SHIFT — Inclusive workshop uniforms from a fixed block, 14 deliverables

config.text:
# COMMON SHIFT

## Project
- Range: inclusive workshop uniforms from an existing block.
- Setting: storage-unit assembly at benches, shelves and floor level.
- Styles: J01 jacket; T01 trousers.
- Fit profiles: A, B, C.
- Measurement and movement records: 03-fit-and-task-records.en.md.

## Existing construction
- J01: stand collar, set-in sleeves, centre-front separating zip, straight hem.
- T01: straight legs, elasticated waistband, centre-front zipped fly.
- Joint panels: elbow and knee zones.
- Jacket pockets: two lower front patch pockets.
- Trouser pockets: two outer-thigh patch pockets centred on the outer seams.
- Total pockets per outfit: four.
- Each pocket: horizontal opening 180 mm; usable depth 220 mm.

## Material
| Code | Composition | Weight | Usable width | Weave | Finish |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F01 | 65% polyester, 35% cotton | 245 g/m² | 1500 mm | 2/1 twill | Preshrunk |

## Construction and hardware
- Seam allowance: 10 mm.
- Main seams: lockstitched and overlocked.
- Topstitching: two rows, 6 mm apart.
- Pocket opening corners: 20 mm bartacks.
- Jacket fastening: size 5 separating coil zip.
- Trouser fastening: size 5 closed-end coil zip.
- Each zip pull: fabric loop with a clear opening of 30 × 15 mm.
- Waistband elastic: 40 mm wide.
- Reflective trim R01: silver glass-bead tape on polyester backing, 50 mm wide.

## Colour and identification
- Main panels: #263C46.
- Elbow and knee panels: #B8C3BD.
- Inside back-neck label wording: COMMON SHIFT.
- Left-chest badge: 90 × 45 mm, landscape orientation.
- Badge wording: WORKSHOP 04.
- Badge emblem: three ascending steps.
- Badge colours: #263C46 field and #B8C3BD emblem, lettering and border.
- Reflective bands per outfit: three.
- Jacket band: one horizontal circuit; upper edge 100 mm above finished hem; centre-front zip interruption.
- Trouser bands: one horizontal circuit per leg; upper edge 200 mm above finished hem.

## Working states
- A: upward reach, shoulder elevation 150°.
- B: seated assembly, hip and knee flexion 90°.
- C: low-level assembly, knee flexion 110°.
- Movement sequence: A, B, C; 4 seconds each; total 12 seconds.

# COMMON SHIFT — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |

| 2 | outfit-front | B outfit front flat | 14 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | outfit-back | B outfit back flat | 14 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | standing-a | Profile A standing outfit | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | standing-b | Profile B standing outfit | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | standing-c | Profile C standing outfit | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | reach-a | Profile A upward reach | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | seated-b | Profile B seated assembly | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | squat-c | Profile C low-level assembly | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 10 | fastening-details | Three-profile fastening details | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | pocket-panel-details | Pocket and joint-panel comparison | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

| 14 | range-presentation | Uniform sampling presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

# COMMON SHIFT fit and task records

## Measurement definitions
- Units: mm unless an angle is stated.
- Body chest, waist and hip: full circumferences.
- Body sleeve length: shoulder point to wrist along the outer arm.
- Body trouser length: side waist to ankle.
- Finished jacket chest and hem: full circumferences with the zip closed.
- Finished sleeve length: shoulder seam to cuff along the upper sleeve.
- Finished jacket back length: centre-back neck seam to hem.
- Finished trouser waist: full circumference, relaxed and fully extended.
- Finished trouser outseam: top of waistband to hem.
- Finished trouser inseam: crotch junction to hem.
- High shoulder point: shoulder seam at the neck.
- Jacket pocket vertical coordinate: high shoulder point to upper opening edge.
- Jacket pocket horizontal coordinate: centre front to inner pocket edge on each side.
- Badge vertical coordinate: high shoulder point to badge upper edge.
- Badge horizontal coordinate: centre front to badge inner edge on the wearer's left.
- Elbow seam coordinate: shoulder seam to panel centre seam along upper sleeve.
- Knee seam coordinate: top of waistband to panel centre seam along outseam.

## Body profiles
| Profile | Stature | Chest | Waist | Hip | Sleeve length | Trouser length |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 1580 | 960 | 840 | 1060 | 540 | 930 |
| B | 1780 | 1040 | 920 | 1040 | 620 | 1070 |
| C | 1660 | 1280 | 1160 | 1340 | 570 | 980 |

## Finished garment dimensions
| Profile | J01 chest | J01 hem | J01 sleeve | J01 back length | T01 waist relaxed | T01 waist extended | T01 hip | T01 outseam | T01 inseam |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 1120 | 1180 | 560 | 680 | 840 | 1000 | 1180 | 950 | 680 |
| B | 1200 | 1160 | 640 | 740 | 920 | 1080 | 1160 | 1090 | 810 |
| C | 1480 | 1500 | 590 | 730 | 1160 | 1320 | 1500 | 1000 | 700 |

## Fastenings and placements
| Profile | J01 zip length | T01 fly zip length | Jacket pocket vertical | Jacket pocket horizontal | Thigh pocket top below waistband | Elbow seam coordinate | Knee seam coordinate | Badge vertical | Badge horizontal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 540 | 160 | 390 | 70 | 220 | 330 | 560 | 160 | 45 |
| B | 600 | 180 | 440 | 80 | 260 | 380 | 640 | 180 | 45 |
| C | 590 | 200 | 410 | 90 | 240 | 350 | 580 | 170 | 45 |

## B block construction geometry
- Jacket shoulder span: 460 mm.
- Jacket chest flat width: 600 mm.
- Jacket hem flat width: 580 mm.
- Jacket neckline width: 140 mm.
- Jacket stand collar height: 40 mm.
- Jacket sleeve upper-edge length: 640 mm.
- Jacket cuff flat width: 130 mm.
- Trouser waist flat width, relaxed: 460 mm.
- Trouser hip flat width: 580 mm.
- Trouser crotch level below waistband: 280 mm.
- Trouser leg opening flat width: 150 mm per leg.
- Jacket zip upper stop: 60 mm below the centre-front neck seam in each profile.
- Fly zip upper stop: 40 mm below the top of the waistband in each profile.

## Task records
| Profile | Shared role | Task | Position | Object or surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Workshop assembler | Returning a light component to an upper shelf | Both shoulders elevated 150 degrees from arms-down; elbows extended | Component tray 240 × 160 × 40 mm |
| B | Workshop assembler | Fitting a bracket at a seated bench | Hip flexion 90 degrees; knee flexion 90 degrees; feet supported | Seat height 460 mm; bench height 740 mm |
| C | Workshop assembler | Reaching a lower assembly joint | Knee flexion 110 degrees; feet on floor | Joint centre 350 mm above floor |

## Angle convention
- Shoulder elevation: 0 degrees with the arm beside the torso.
- Knee flexion: 0 degrees with a straight leg.
- Hip flexion: 0 degrees in upright standing.

steps.userMessage:
COMMON SHIFT | Inclusive workshop uniforms from a fixed block

Our workshop team assembles storage units at benches, shelves and floor level. Develop jacket J01 and trousers T01 from our existing block for fit profiles A, B and C. The jacket has a stand collar, set-in sleeves and a centre-front zip; the trousers have straight legs, an elasticated waistband and a zipped fly. Retain this construction while developing the elbow and knee panels, access details and colour blocking. The attached records give separate body measurements, finished garment dimensions and task positions for each profile.

Use fabric F01 throughout: 65% polyester and 35% cotton, 245 g/m², 1500 mm usable width, 2/1 twill with a preshrunk finish. Main panels are #263C46; elbow and knee panels are #B8C3BD. Each outfit has four pockets: two lower jacket pockets and two outer-thigh pockets, each with a 180 mm opening and 220 mm usable depth. Silver reflective tape is 50 mm wide, with one horizontal band around the jacket and one around each trouser leg. Print "COMMON SHIFT" on the inside back-neck label and "WORKSHOP 04" on the existing 90 × 45 mm left-chest badge, preserving its three-step emblem.

Audience: workshop staff, the clothing buyer and the garment maker, choosing a shared uniform and the three fits to take into sampling.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed garment, material and identification facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables, proportions, formats and stages. 03-fit-and-task-records.en.md contains the body measurements, garment dimensions, placement coordinates and assigned movements. base-block.png records the existing construction and dimensioned B block alongside the three body profiles. task-positions.png defines the three working poses. workshop-badge.png supplies the existing badge and reflective tape sample. assembly-workshop.png provides the working environment, lighting and material atmosphere.

Deliverables:
1. One materials and craft sheet establishing F01 composition, weight, width, weave and finish; seam construction, hardware, and the A/B/C dimension mapping for COMMON SHIFT styles J01 and T01
2. Two flat-lay drawings of the complete B outfit, one front and one back, with garment dimensions, panel seams, pockets, tape and an inset of the back-neck label
3. Three standing outfit views, one each for A, B and C, labelled with profile, stature, chest, waist and hip measurements
4. Three working outfit views: A reaching upward at 150° shoulder elevation, B seated with 90° hip and knee flexion, and C squatting with 110° knee flexion, each paired with its standing view through matching garment details
5. One fastening detail board comparing all three jacket zips and trouser flies, including the 30 × 15 mm clear pull-loop opening and open and closed states
6. One pocket and joint-panel detail board comparing A, B and C, with all four pocket positions per outfit, opening dimensions, and elbow and knee seam locations
7. One identification and colour sheet locating the neck label, chest badge, three reflective bands and two panel colours across front and back views
8. One 12-second movement video with consecutive 4-second sections for A reaching, B sitting and C squatting, reusing the corresponding outfits
9. One 10-page presentation reusing the materials sheet, flats, six wearer views and detail boards, with a size comparison and a sampling summary

Acceptance:
- The materials and craft sheet, both flat-lay drawings, fastening detail board and presentation identify COMMON SHIFT, J01, T01 and F01; the fastening board and presentation repeat jacket zip lengths of A 540 mm, B 600 mm and C 590 mm from the materials sheet.
- The standing and working views carry the correct profile labels and body measurements: A 1580/960/840/1060 mm, B 1780/1040/920/1040 mm and C 1660/1280/1160/1340 mm in stature/chest/waist/hip order. Their garments follow the corresponding finished dimensions in 03-fit-and-task-records.en.md.
- The pocket and joint-panel board, standing views and working views retain four pockets per outfit with 180 mm openings and 220 mm usable depths; jacket pocket openings sit A 390 mm, B 440 mm and C 410 mm below the high shoulder point, with elbow and knee seams at their recorded positions.
- Both flat-lay drawings and the identification and colour sheet show the 90 × 45 mm badge with WORKSHOP 04 and its three-step emblem, the COMMON SHIFT neck label, #263C46 main panels and #B8C3BD joint panels. The identification sheet dimensions all three 50 mm reflective bands and their recorded hem offsets.
- The three working views and 12-second video use the assigned 150°, 90° and 110° poses; each profile keeps its standing view's fastening length, pocket placement, panel seams and badge position throughout its movement.
- The 10-page presentation includes all three fit profiles, repeats F01 and its five material facts, and carries forward the A/B/C fastening dimensions and front/back identification arrangement from the earlier sheets.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
